steps.title: Tank north, party south
steps.rule: Stack just inside waymark 3, behind the boss, and stay out of its front half for the Double Sobat on the main tank.

MainTank.rule: Tank Lindwurm from the north, halfway to waymark 1, facing it away from the party. Take the first kick of Double Sobat with mitigation.

steps.title: Tanks spread out of the second kick
steps.cue: The first Double Sobat kick lands
steps.rule: Stay stacked behind the boss on waymark 3. The second kick hits north again and Esoteric Finisher drops a circle on each tank.

MainTank.rule: Sprint north-west, out of the narrow second kick that follows the first, and take your Esoteric Finisher circle there.

OffTank.rule: Go north-east, away from the party and the main tank, and take your Esoteric Finisher circle there.

steps.title: Back to tank north, party south
steps.rule: Stack again just inside waymark 3, behind the boss.

MainTank.rule: Return to the north spot halfway to waymark 1 and keep the boss facing north.
